design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (folio_charges_and_adjustments), revision 2

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1: {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 5]}. folio_ext_weekly_parking_cap takes 4 factors, folio_ext_self_parking_savings 5, folio_ext_valet_parking_savings 5. Occupied by task 0: the elite breakfast and dining family. Claimed here: the parking family of folio_adjustment (parking_self / parking_valet lines only; these charge codes trigger no loyalty points reversal) and tools correct_self_parking_29958fbc, correct_valet_parking_0a0ec721 (agent) and elect_weekly_parking_5ade5692 (user). Nothing is left unclaimed. The stay is in house (folio open).

[Why it is a good test] The guest asks only to switch his stay to the weekly parking maximum and to confirm it himself. The weekly-maximum rule carries two prerequisite sentences: "The weekly parking maximum of a stay is applied only after the self-parking lines of the stay carry the Ashbury Rewards parking savings they are owed." and "The weekly parking maximum of a stay is not worked out until the valet lines of the stay carry the Ashbury Rewards valet savings they are owed." No parking line carries a saving, so the agent must find both savings rules, compute them (5 factors each, across the membership and the reservation), post them against the most recent line of each service, then compute the excess (4 factors) on the parking net of those corrections and post it on the seventh night parked, so that no line is adjusted twice.

[Problem-tree card] root folio_ext_weekly_parking_cap (owner user). Edge S -> folio_ext_self_parking_savings: value_input, gate self_corrections, state form, affirmative "applied only after". Edge V -> folio_ext_valet_parking_savings: value_input, gate valet_corrections, state form, negated "not worked out until" (the charter carries both directions). Each state is brought about by exactly one write: only correct_self_parking_29958fbc books parking savings on self-parking lines and only correct_valet_parking_0a0ec721 books valet savings on valet lines; the weekly correction uses another reason. Opening falsity: four self-parking lines (September 27-30) and four valet lines (October 1-4), and the only standing adjustment names a duplicate minibar line. The prerequisites commute: a replay with the valet savings first gives the same values and the same terminal hash (balance 3227.33). Deletion sensitivity: skip the self-parking savings -> excess 93.28; skip the valet savings -> 103.48; gold 55.48.

[Base-invariant card] Subject folio_adjustment, governed by folio_agg_courtesy_allowance (courtesy_within_allowance: not a minibar courtesy removal; folio and customer correlate) and folio_evt_adjustment: correctable_state (folio open), dispute_window (time gate, anchor actual_check_out_date empty because the guest is in house; Ashbury Grand window 90 days, inclusive, day zero = check-out), one_adjustment_per_line (September 30 self, October 4 valet and October 3 valet each corrected once; the only prior adjustment names a minibar line), desk_limit (37.80 + 48.00 + 55.48 = 141.28 <= 350.00; the hotel's own duplicate correction carries a line number and does not count). Declared override: folio_incidental_rules "Parking is charged per night a vehicle is parked at self_parking_per_night_usd or, where valet_available is true, valet_parking_per_night_usd;". Revision 2 drops the earlier declarations against the base late-check-out elite_benefit_not_applied clause and the room incorrect_rate clause: both base corrections stay fully in force, and the parking corrections add their own cases under those reason codes.

[Business-object card] Folio 3268412, the only folio. Self-parking savings: the four self-parking lines, booked against the most recent (September 30). Valet savings: the four valet lines, booked against October 4. Weekly maximum: all eight parking lines net of their corrections, booked against the seventh night parked (October 3). Excluded: room, tax, destination fee, the dinner, both minibar lines and the hotel's minibar duplicate correction.

[Factor card — self-parking savings (5)] tier_parking_benefit (method): Titanium -> supplemented, combined 11% + 4 = 15% (Ambassador would be scaled x2; baseline as it stands -> 27.72). card_parking_saving (parameter): Ashbury Rewards Card 2% (-> 32.76). engagement_parking_saving (parameter): 64 night credits 2% (-> 32.76). stay_length_parking_saving (parameter): 9-night reservation 3% (-> 30.24; near-miss: 8 nights stayed). member_rate_multiplier (parameter, multi-source: reservation rate plan AND membership tier, both non-fall-through tiers compound): Member Flexible Rate AND Titanium -> 1.5 (-> 25.20). 4 x 42.00 x 15% x 1.5 = 37.80; whole baseline 6.72.
[Factor card — valet savings (5)] valet_saving_method (method): Titanium -> (58.00 - 42.00) x 0.5 = 8.00/night (baseline 2.32/night -> 25.28); rate plan +1.50 (-> 42.00); channel +1.00 (-> 44.00); engagement +0.50 (-> 46.00); stay length +1.00 (-> 44.00). 12.00 x 4 = 48.00; whole baseline 9.28.
[Factor card — weekly maximum (4)] weekly_basis_rate (parameter): Titanium -> self-parking rate 42.00 (baseline: rate of the service parked on the most recent night, valet 58.00 -> 0.00). chargeable_nights_per_week (parameter): Titanium 5.5 (baseline 6 -> 31.96). maximum_method (method, multi-source: membership tier AND reservation channel): Titanium AND mobile app -> pro-rated 231.00 / 7 x 8 = 264.00 (baseline one full week + one remaining night = 273.00 -> 46.66; a Gold or Platinum member booked direct gets full weeks at the weekly rate plus the remaining nights at the basis rate with those remaining nights capped at half the weekly rate — distinct from the fall-through whenever four or more nights remain (machine grid: 105 of 245 basis/week/remainder cases differ, never higher); a GDS or rooming-list booking falls through). rate_plan_maximum_discount (parameter): Member Flexible Rate 2% (-> 50.20). Maximum 258.72; excess 400.00 - 85.80 - 258.72 = 55.48; whole baseline 0.00.

[Seed] Customer; Titanium membership consistent with loyalty_elite_qualification: 2025 night credits 30 (03-15), 15 card anniversary (05-14), 31 (08-22, the count reaches 76 that day -> Titanium effective 2025-08-22, guaranteed through the last day of February 2027), 6 (12-05); reset of 82 on 2026-01-01; 2026 credits 24 (03-08), 15 card anniversary (05-14), 25 (07-12) = 64 = elite_night_credits. The Ashbury Rewards Card floors at Silver, below the earned tier. Points 31,480 + 23,610 + 39,170 = 94,260. In-house Member Flexible Rate reservation (mobile app, 9 nights, 1 adult, 279.00, 17.40%, card guarantee). Open folio, 44 lines: 8 nights of room 279.00 / tax 48.55 / destination fee 28.00 / its tax 4.87; self-parking 42.00 x 4; valet 58.00 x 4; dinner 71.25; minibar 14.00 posted twice with the hotel's duplicate_posting correction. balance_due 3368.61. No breakfast line, so the breakfast benefit owes nothing; every other line matches the brand.

[Persona] Daniel Gutierrez, brisk tired consultant; volunteers the weekly-maximum request and that he has parked every night; identity and stay facts only on request; one passive consent if the agent says something must be posted first; confirms the election himself and closes.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify (312-555-2093, 30309) -> folio -> lines -> reservation -> membership -> account activity -> self-parking savings 37.80 on September 30 -> valet savings 48.00 on October 4 -> unlock_user + guest elects the weekly maximum, 55.48 on October 3. Terminal balance 3227.33. The rule states that the election covers the nights parked up to the moment it is made; tonight's line posts afterwards as posted.

[Verification run] authoring calc over the replayed handling-time worlds: 37.8 / 48.0 / 55.48; factor baselines as above; skips 93.28 / 103.48; swapped prerequisite order gives an identical terminal hash.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the three rules, the folio lines, the reservation and the membership alone, the same three writes, objects and amounts follow; the target lines follow from "most recent line of that service" and "seventh night parked". Single reading.

[Revision 2 — audit closure] T1-F1/F-3: the self-parking computation's method is now the tier parking benefit (scaled for Ambassador, supplemented for Titanium, as it stands otherwise — different operations, the shape the audit accepted for the per-person breakfast credit); the member-rate multiplier is relabelled a parameter. T1-F2/F-4: weekly_basis_rate is relabelled a parameter, and its fall-through is now the rate of the service parked on the most recent night (no longer the valet rate for every other guest). T1-F3/F-5: nights_counted (which had a conjunct true for every eligible guest and counted unparked reservation nights) is replaced by maximum_method: pro-rated vs full weeks plus remaining nights, capped vs plain, chosen by tier and booking channel. T1-F4/F-7: maximum_method and member_rate_multiplier each combine conditions over two distinct records (membership and reservation). T1-F5/F-8: the tier date, guarantee date and night-credit history follow loyalty_elite_qualification. F-2: over-broad reason-clause overrides removed. O-4: the rule counts nights parked as parking lines. T1 observation (tonight's line): the rule states that the election covers the nights parked so far. Figures moved: excess 32.05 -> 55.48, terminal 3250.76 -> 3227.33.

[Revision 3 — audit closure] T1-N1/N-1: the Gold/Platinum tier of maximum_method previously capped the total at the weeks rounded up, which can never bind under 6 chargeable nights, so it equalled the fall-through. It now caps the remaining nights at half the weekly rate, a real half-week maximum. That is a distinct outcome for remainders of four to six nights, and the customer's tier, figures and gold are unchanged (55.48). O-8: the rule and the baseline now state the same-night tie-break ('When the most recent night parked carries both a self-parking and a valet line, the service of that night is valet.'), which matches the compute. O-7: no change. The parking corrections reuse base reason codes outside the cases base lists for them. No base sentence assigns any amount to a parking line under those reasons, the base late check-out and room-rate cases stay in force, and the auditor records no second amount.
user_scenario:
You are Daniel Gutierrez, a management consultant from Atlanta, on a nine-night project stay at the Ashbury Grand Chicago. It is Monday evening, you have just got back to your room after a long day at the client's office, and you are calling guest services. You are friendly but brisk and a little tired, you speak in short sentences, and you like to get things done in one call. You are an Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite member and you booked this stay yourself on the Ashbury app.

You have had your car at the hotel every night since you arrived: the first few nights you used the self-parking garage, and since the garage got busy you have been leaving it with the valet. This morning the valet attendant mentioned that guests who park for a week or more can switch their parking to the hotel's weekly parking maximum, and that it is the guest who has to opt into it. You want to switch to it now, for this stay, and you understand that you have to confirm the switch yourself; you are not asking for any other discount. You open with something like: "Hi, Daniel Gutierrez, I'm in house at the Grand. The valet told me there's a weekly parking maximum if you park a week or longer — I've had my car here every night. Can I switch to that? Tell me what I need to do."

You give your details only when the agent asks. Your phone number is 312-555-2093, the postal code on your billing address is 30309, your email is daniel.gutierrez@lakeshoremail.com, your date of birth is 1984-11-03 and the card on file ends in 2264. Your confirmation number is 72590314 and your Ashbury Rewards member number is 402874519. If asked about the stay, you arrived on September 27th and check out on October 6th, you are alone in the room, and you self-parked the first four nights and used the valet from October 1st on. You do not know what any of it adds up to and you would rather the agent read the figures off the folio than guess; if the agent asks whether you looked at the bill, you say you only glanced at the total.

If the agent tells you that something else on your bill has to be put right or posted by the desk first, you say "Sure, go ahead, do whatever needs doing so it's right," and you do not ask about it further. When the agent tells you the amount that comes off for the weekly maximum and hands the confirmation over to you, you confirm it yourself exactly as the agent describes, using the folio, profile and parking-charge references and the amount the agent gives you, and you read the confirmation back if asked. You do not question the figure. Once you have confirmed the switch and seen the confirmation, you say thanks, that you are going to grab dinner, and end the call.
